notes_for_editor: Two sources only, and both are lists: the tnlandforms.us inventory row (HDT002: Old Union, 617 ft, Hardin, '7-26 removed') and a name-and-county list on Eastern US Lookouts. Neither gives a build date, builder, height, staffing, fire, or access record. Two web searches found no history for this tower. The search also surfaced an Old Union Church Cemetery in Hardin County and an Old Union Road in Sequatchie County; neither was read or cited, and neither is known to be linked to the tower. The 'removed' label is not defined on the inventory page. The Tennessee Division of Forestry site returned HTTP 403 and was not read. The 2015 multiple-property study is named in search snippets but was not opened. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
